scope.model: Hughes 2019 lenalidomide deterministic typical-value educational implementation
scope.users: Developers and researchers exploring the mathematics of an explicitly synthetic scenario.
scope.setting: Local educational software development and model-method inspection.
scope.supported_decisions: Software/model investigation only; no clinical treatment decision.
scope.population: Declared synthetic profiles under the existing execution contract; this does not establish clinical population applicability.
scope.outputs: Model-derived concentration curves, exposure summaries, saved-run comparisons and declared clearance sensitivity.
scope.decision_boundary: None of these outputs is a validated individual patient prediction.

permitted_uses: Inspect deterministic PK mathematics using declared synthetic inputs.
Compare compatible archived educational calculations and inspect parameter sensitivity.
Review numerical checks, source bindings and independent-review preparation.
Plan evidence acquisition and validation without claiming completed validation.
prohibited_uses: Select or adjust a real patient dose, treatment, schedule or monitoring plan.
Predict individual efficacy, toxicity, adverse-event probability or therapeutic suitability.
Present sensitivity scenarios as confidence intervals or population variability.
Represent transit states as measured anatomical organ concentrations.
Treat source-range membership, a drug-name match or a passed software test as clinical applicability.
Enter identifiable real-patient records into this synthetic educational workflow.

failure_modes.failure: Indexed eGFR or total body weight is substituted for the explicitly required CrCl or FFM.
failure_modes.consequence: Apparent parameter values and calculated exposure may be misleading.
recorded_controls: Unit/type checks and separate explicit model-covariate inputs.
failure_modes.remaining_gap: Covariate methods and their clinical provenance are not independently authenticated.

failure_modes.failure: Incorrect concentration conversion, units or absorption/central ordering.
failure_modes.consequence: Concentration magnitude or time profile may be wrong.
recorded_controls: Numerical audit and source transcription review packet.
failure_modes.remaining_gap: Independent qualified transcription review is pending.

failure_modes.failure: A source contract or saved report changes without a traceable model version.
failure_modes.consequence: An educational output may lose reproducibility or be attributed to the wrong source.
recorded_controls: Source contract hashes and saved payload integrity checks.
failure_modes.remaining_gap: Hash consistency does not authenticate source origin or establish scientific correctness.

failure_modes.failure: Marginal source coverage or a synthetic disease declaration is interpreted as patient applicability.
failure_modes.consequence: An unsupported model result may influence an individual-level conclusion.
recorded_controls: Coverage limitations and bounded execution policy.
failure_modes.remaining_gap: Joint coverage and fit-for-purpose applicability have not been established.

failure_modes.failure: Deterministic ETA-zero output or clearance sensitivity is treated as a probabilistic prediction.
failure_modes.consequence: Precision or confidence may be overstated.
recorded_controls: Deterministic and sensitivity limitations recorded in reports.
failure_modes.remaining_gap: Population/residual variability, covariance and calibrated uncertainty are not implemented.

failure_modes.failure: PK exposure is treated as evidence of efficacy or toxicity for an individual.
failure_modes.consequence: A clinical claim may be made without an exposure-response model or endpoint validation.
recorded_controls: Clinical prediction validated and patient simulation ready remain false.
Validation-gap report records absent response-model evidence.
failure_modes.remaining_gap: No validated PK/PD, clinical endpoint or adverse-effect risk model is connected.

failure_modes.failure: Project execution limits or proposed governance text is described as published validation or accepted policy.
failure_modes.consequence: Users may believe the system has scientific or institutional approval it does not have.
recorded_controls: Project policy is separated from source transcription in Step 56.
failure_modes.remaining_gap: No named governance reviewers or acceptance decision are recorded.

failure_modes.failure: Real identifiable patient data is entered into the educational workflow.
failure_modes.consequence: Sensitive information may be stored without an assessed data-handling workflow.
failure_modes.remaining_gap: No privacy/security readiness assessment or real-patient data workflow is established.

review_roles.responsibility: Independently review source transcription, definitions and discrepancies.
Review code changes, numerical checks and regression evidence.
Review scope, misuse risks, intended outputs and remaining validation gaps.

requirements: Record the changed artifact, reason, source and affected model/contract versions.
Assess effects on equations, units, covariates, numerical behavior, assumptions and intended use.
Run relevant verification checks and retain evidence for independent review.
Preserve archived runs and their original source bindings; do not silently recompute or rewrite them.
Keep proposed review and validation status explicit until actual reviewer decisions exist.
incident_handling: Record a suspected defect and affected versions/output IDs.
Withhold interpretation of affected outputs while investigating.
Document correction, verification and the impact on prior educational outputs.

limitations: This is a project-specific draft, not a regulatory or institutional classification.
Recorded controls are references to project behavior, not evidence that all controls have been comprehensively evaluated.
No risk probability, calibrated severity score or residual-risk acceptance is claimed.
